description: This file contains service functions for managing evaluations, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and checking evaluation status within a system. It interacts with database entities, external modules, and handles evaluation workflows and data processing.

methods.name: runAgain
methods.description: Re-runs an evaluation by its ID, preparing evaluation data and invoking createEvaluation.

methods.name: createEvaluation
methods.description: Creates a new evaluation, saves it to the database, and initiates evaluation runs, handling success and error states.

methods.name: getAllEvaluations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of evaluations with pagination, grouped by name, including latest run info and versioning.

methods.name: deleteEvaluation
methods.description: Deletes an evaluation and its associated evaluation runs by ID.

methods.name: isOutdated
methods.description: Checks if an evaluation is outdated based on dataset and chatflow updates.

methods.name: getEvaluation
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific evaluation, including version and run data.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves all versions of an evaluation sorted by run date.

methods.name: patchDeleteEvaluations
methods.description: Deletes multiple evaluations and optionally all their versions.
